The first end is therefore recorded as 1960-10-16, the effective date the superseding order states for itself; the order was signed December 2, 1960 and published December 6, 1960, so the alternative reading dates the supersession 1960-12-02. The actor is the President (Dwight D. Eisenhower) and the mechanism is express supersession of the entire order, which had a single operative paragraph. The delegation is replaced by section 1(a) and (c) of the superseding order, so the clause has no continuing predicate on 2026-10-14.

The command was therefore performed on issue, 1939-06-29 (actor: the President, Franklin D. Roosevelt; mechanism: performance of a self-executing amendment). The paragraph it inserted continued in the Rules only for the period it states is "ending June 30, 1940", and that period is a term of the inserted rule, not a continuing command of this order. No continuing predicate exists for 2026-10-14.
